intro: Professionals and everyday users convert miles per hour (mph) to feet per second (ft/s) when working across imperial and imperial standards in automotive speedometer readings, aviation airspeed navigation, maritime chart plotting, and meteorology. One miles per hour equals 1.466667 feet per second, while 1 feet per second equals 0.681818 miles per hour. Whether you are verifying speed specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many feet per second (ft/s) are in 1 miles per hour (mph)?
faqs.answer: There are 1.46666667 feet per second (ft/s) in 1 miles per hour (mph), which rounds to 1.4667 ft/s for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 feet per second equals 0.681818 miles per hour.

faqs.question: How do I convert miles per hour to feet per second (mph to ft/s)?
faqs.answer: To convert miles per hour to feet per second, use the formula: ft/s = mph × 1.46666667. For example, converting 50 mph gives 73.3333 ft/s.

faqs.question: What is 50 miles per hour in feet per second?
faqs.answer: 50 miles per hour (mph) equals exactly 73.3333 feet per second (ft/s) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
